title: Shopper recruitment cards
slide_intent: Show how to repeat a campaign structure while varying its invitation. A returning viewer can recognize the series and still encounter a different reason to become a shopper.
strategic_value: A recurring card format can connect several appeals to one recruitment action, leaving the illustrations to give each a distinct mood.
demonstration: Three pale portrait cards sit on a dark green ground. Each pairs a short headline and the same shopper prompt with a different colorful illustration and a signature below.
practical_value: Keep the prompt and signature in place while varying the headline, subject and illustration field for the next card in the series.

content_islands.name: Recruitment series
content_islands.spec: Center three cards of equal size. Align headlines, prompts and small circular arrows at the top.

content_islands.name: Illustrations and signatures
content_islands.spec: Within each card place a large rounded illustration beneath the prompt and a small wordmark at the bottom. Compare the fruit, shopper and coin subjects in sequence.
